mapper.select: /* projInqyDao1010 : 프로젝트 시퀀스 조회 */ SELECT 'PROJ_' || LPAD(NVL(MAX(REPLACE(PROJ_CD,'PROJ_')),0) + 1,4,0) AS SEQUENCE_ID FROM PROJECT

/* projInqyDao1030 : 프로젝트 상세 */ SELECT P.PROJ_ID , P.PROJ_TITLE , P.PROJ_CONT , TO_CHAR(P.PROJ_SDT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PROJ_SDT , TO_CHAR(P.PROJ_EDT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PROJ_EDT , P.STATUS_CD , C.CODE_NM AS STATUS_NM , P.OWNER_IDX , E.EMP_NM AS OWNER_NM , E.ORG_CD , O.ORG_NM , E.RANK_CD , R.RANK_NM , P.REG_IDX , TO_CHAR(P.REG_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS REG_DT , P.MOD_IDX , TO_CHAR(P.MOD_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS MOD_DT , P.USE_YN , P.DISP_ORDER , P.REMARK FROM PROJECT P LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_INFO E ON P.OWNER_IDX = E.EMP_IDX LEFT OUTER JOIN ORG O ON O.ORG_CD = E.ORG_CD AND O.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN RANK R ON R.RANK_CD = E.RANK_CD AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN CODE C ON C.CODE_CD = P.STATUS_CD WHERE P.PROJ_ID = #{projId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: /* projProcDao1010 : 프로젝트 등록 처리 */ INSERT INTO PROJECT ( PROJ_ID , PROJ_TITLE , PROJ_CONT , PROJ_SDT , PROJ_EDT , STATUS_CD , OWNER_IDX , REG_IDX , REG_DT , USE_YN , DISP_ORDER , REMARK ) VALUES ( (SELECT 'PROJ_' || LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(PROJ_ID, 'PROJ_', ''))), 0) + 1, 4, '0') FROM PROJECT) , #{projTitle, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{projCont, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , TO_DATE(#{projSdt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , TO_DATE(#{projEdt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') , #{statusCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{ownerIdx, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{regIdx, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , SYSDATE , 'Y' , (SELECT NVL(MAX(DISP_ORDER), 0) + 1 FROM PROJECT) , NULL )
